summary: Iteration 22 features (staff email invites, deal results, door guest search, night summary trends) tested end-to-end. Backend: 33/33 pytest pass (new iter22 file 6 tests + updated iter21 16 + iter20 11 regression). Frontend (390x844 web preview): Invited badge, /sign-up?email= prefill, DealCard deal-results on upcoming + past events, SummaryCard with avg + % change, live Find-a-guest search + check-in (owner and door-staff views) all work. Found 1 UI bug (Invited badge text wraps vertically) and a few minor backend issues (unencoded invite link email, guest search 200-user cap). No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: Sign-up link puts the email in the URL without URL-encoding: routes/staff.py:95 f"/sign-up?email={email}". Addresses with '+' (e.g. a+b@x.io) prefill as 'a b@x.io' (checked in UI), so the invite isn't claimed if the user doesn't spot it. Fix: urllib.parse.quote(email, safe='').

hostlive.py:179 searches ALL users with the regex and stops at limit(200), then filters to this event's tickets. With a big user base, common queries ('an', 'jo') can return no results even when ticket holders match. Fix: load this event's ticket user_ids first, then match users with {'id': {'$in': ids}, '$or': [...]}.
night_stats(ev) runs twice (lines 256 and 270), which doubles the ticket/table/payable queries. Reuse the first result.

The collection has no indexes (only _id). Every check-in, live view and registration (claim_invites) queries venue_id/user_id/email. Add indexes on (venue_id, user_id, active) and (email, user_id, active).

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile the 'Invited' badge gets squeezed to about 30px wide and its text wraps vertically ('In/vit/ed'). Cause: an invited row's name is the full email, and the name Text has no flexShrink or numberOfLines. Reference: frontend/src/door-staff-card.tsx:74-76,106-111. Fix: name {flexShrink:1} + numberOfLines={1}, badge {flexShrink:0}.

issues: Invited rows show the email twice (name = email, then 'email · venue'). Show the email once with a 'Pending sign-up' subline instead.

If GET /host/venues fails, the screen shows 'Add your venue when you post your first event.' and hides the Door staff card, which is a misleading error state (app/host/index.tsx:45-49). Show an error or retry instead.
On web, focusing the TextInput draws a white rectangle outline inside the rounded input. Add outlineStyle:'none' (web) to styles.input in src/guest-search.tsx:78.
Door staff see guests' full name and email in search, but the Door staff card copy says staff can see 'nothing else'. Consider masking the email for is_staff_view, or changing the copy.

action_items: Fix the Invited badge wrapping in door-staff-card.tsx (name flexShrink:1 + numberOfLines=1, badge flexShrink:0).
URL-encode the email in the invite sign-up link (routes/staff.py:95).
Restrict guest search to this event's ticket holders before applying the regex and limit (hostlive.py:179).
Optional: reuse night_stats in night_report; add door_staff indexes; show a real error state in Host Studio when venues fail to load; add web outline:none to the guest search input.
critical_code_review_comments: claim_invites is called on email register and on new Google users. Existing users are linked when they're invited, so that flow is covered.
Removed (active=false) invites are correctly not claimed on sign-up (tested).
Deal results window ($gte sent_at, $lte expires_at, user_ids) is correct. Before-deal, after-expiry and non-waitlisted tickets are excluded (tested). revenue = total_paid + credit_used.
Guest search uses re.escape, so regex special characters are safe (tested '(Regex.*)', 'Z.*Q', '[(').
seed_data_creation: iter22_ui_seed.py seed/clean created a TEST_ venue, events, tickets, payables, a TEST_ user and door_staff rows. All were removed by id, and the UI-created staff row was deleted too. No deal or summary_sent flags were left on non-test events, and seeded users' wallet and credit are unchanged (0). The 2 inactive door_staff rows on Club Noire predate this run and were left alone.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_nocturne_iter22_invites_dealresults_search_trends.py test_nocturne_iter21_deals_staff_summary.py -n 0. Invite emails are tested in-process via mods fixture (emailer.send_email patched) by calling staff._invite_email directly; HTTP invites to unknown emails send a real email (use test_ addresses). TEST_ venues inserted directly into the DB must include the full VenueOut fields (state, category, image_url, rating, price_range, description, min_level), or GET /host/venues returns 500 and Host Studio hides the Door staff card. send_night_summaries in tests: snapshot unflagged non-test events in the 36h window and $unset summary_sent afterwards. The iter21 test doesn't do this yet, but it found no seeded events in the window this run. Sign-up has role/tier steps (role-next-btn, tier-next-btn) before the form, where signup-email is prefilled.
rca_of_issue: Badge wrap: in the flex row the name Text (a long email) takes all the width and the badge shrinks. Plus-sign prefill: the raw email is interpolated into the query string, so the URL parser decodes '+' as a space.
